name: Concurrency Control
summary:
Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
Retailer (enthusiastic about system improvements/new features).
Summarize a cluster of updates into a cohesive release note entry.
        *   *New Features/Enhancements*: Problem $\rightarrow$ Solution $\rightarrow$ Impact.
        *   *Standalone Bug Fixes*: "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]."

        *   Simpler is better.
        *   Active voice.
        *   Granular but concise (3-4 sentences for features, 1 sentence for bug fixes).
        *   Tone: Professional, utility-focused.
        *   No AI Slop: Avoid "enhanced", "streamlined", "seamless", "robust".
        *   No Exclamation Points: Periods only.
        *   No dev-time bugs: Synthesize "fixes" in new features as polished experiences; don't use "fixed", "issue", or "bug" for new features.
        *   True Bug Fixes: Start with "Fixed a bug...", focus on user-visible symptoms.

    *   *PR 687 (receiving):* Prevents duplicate transfer order receive confirmations. Solves the problem of rapid repeated clicks creating stacked modals and duplicate submissions, which caused inventory duplication. Introduced a state machine (idle, confirming, submitting) and disabled buttons during the flow.
    *   *PR 68
